articles.title: CISA Releases Guidance on Deploying Cyber Decoys
articles.executive_summary: CISA has released guidance on deploying cyber decoys to complement Zero Trust models, enabling organizations to detect and block malicious activity. This move aims to enhance cybersecurity posture and improve incident response.
articles.technical_breakdown: Cyber decoys are designed to mimic legitimate assets, allowing organizations to observe and analyze malicious activity without revealing their actual infrastructure. By deploying decoys, organizations can improve their ability to detect and respond to threats.
actionable_mitigations: Implement Zero Trust architecture to limit lateral movement
Regularly update and patch software and systems
Monitor network traffic and logs for suspicious activity
articles.telegram_snippet: CISA releases guidance on deploying cyber decoys to enhance cybersecurity posture and improve incident response.
